subject: Launch: SI Microcredential Pilot — invite & syllabus
messages:
From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: sara@bluepeak.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch: SI Microcredential Pilot — invite & syllabus

Hi Sara —

Following up from our partner sync last week: we’re ready to kick off a small pilot for the SI Microcredential program and would love BluePeak to be one of the first consultancies to run through it with a cohort of 3–5 engineers. The idea is to provide a short, hands-on badge that proves competency in Redwood inference integration patterns (deployment config, routing policies, and observability hooks). The pilot goals are: 

- Validate curriculum clarity and lab timing (target: 4 hours total, split across two sessions)
- Measure time-to-first-success for a simple workload (embed + chat inference)
- Gather partner feedback on tooling gaps and sales enablement assets

Attached is the one-page syllabus and a calendar invite for a proposed pilot week (see attachments). Proposed timeline: pilot week June 9–13, with a 90-minute kickoff + 90-minute hands-on lab two days later. We’ll supply a sandbox account, short pre-lab checklist, and sample evaluation prompts.

Could you confirm whether BluePeak has 3 engineers who can participate, and whether the proposed week looks feasible? If not, suggest two alternative weeks in June.

Appreciate it — cc’ing Laura and Priyom to coordinate ops and materials.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Nikhil —

Thanks — this sounds great and very pragmatic. BluePeak can commit three consultants: Sara Koh, Luis Mendez, and Priya Shah. June 9–13 looks workable today, though Luis is out June 10 afternoon (we can shift the lab if needed). Two quick questions: 

1) Is the sandbox environment pre-provisioned with the telemetry hooks you mentioned (token-level cost + latency traces), or do we need to bring a small app to exercise them?
2) What’s the success criteria for awarding the microcredential? Is it an instructor-verified lab or a short checklist?

We’re happy to take part and will loop in our enablement lead if Tom from Atlas is co-running labs.

—Sara

Thanks all — quick logistics from the ops side: 

- Sandbox: we will create a per-cohort sandbox with preseeded sample app + telemetry. That environment will include: request/response traces, token-level cost estimates, and an insights dashboard. We’ll share access 48 hours before the kickoff.
- Success criteria: completion of the lab exercises + a short checklist (5 items) verified by the instructor. There will also be a short optional assessment for participants who want a linkable badge.
- Materials: attached pilot_roster_template.csv to capture participants’ names, role, timezone, and laptop/ssh constraints. Please return by May 23.
- Delivery roles: Nikhil will coordinate partner outreach and curriculum; Priyom will own the lab infra and scoring rubric; Grace will handle the instructor slot and final badge issuance.

Sara — please confirm roster by May 23 and whether you want Atlas to co-instruct. If Luis’s afternoon availability is a conflict, we can schedule the lab in the morning of June 11 instead of June 10.

Next steps: 
1) BluePeak confirms roster (May 23)
2) Redwood shares sandbox credentials (by June 7)
3) Pilot kickoff (June 9) + lab (June 11 morning)

Thanks — Laura
